csi_division: Division 23 - Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a linear slot diffuser for the specified perforated face diffuser under Section 23 30 00 due to lead time concerns.
proposed_solution: Substitute linear slot alternate diffuser in lieu of specified perforated face diffuser.
routing_rationale: The substitution involves a specified HVAC diffuser under Division 23, requiring technical and performance evaluation by the mechanical engineer of record.
